info.title: Astra independently authored DEMO API
info.description: Independently authored contracts for all 47 services, immutable office-specific fee assessments, and bKash v2 online checkout with provider verification, stored receipts and gateway reconciliation. These are not reference-site server contracts. Authenticated mutations require session and CSRF; the signed provider callback is separately public. Citizen fees and SaaS credits are separate. Production checkout defaults to disabled pending approved tenant merchant configuration; Nagad and bank payout reconciliation are not integrated. Official identity/signing remain unconfigured and certificates remain DEMO / NOT OFFICIAL. Source version does not establish hosted deployment or live merchant certification. Private attachments enter quarantine and require a hash-bound fresh ClamAV result before download, submission, approval or new issuance. The independently authenticated outbound scanner runs on the owner-selected PC; outages fail closed.

post.summary: Create versioned renewal draft from issued certificate
post.description: Citizen own/staff/admin tenant only. Creates a linked draft for the same service/citizen, with one active successor per source. Source must be issued and unrevoked; trade prior number is server-pinned. Requires a fresh current-policy order when configured, including when the source is legacy. Optional payload is validated against the current schema; otherwise source facts are reused. Current policy fees are recalculated, not copied from the source. Normal separate review/approval and exactly-once SaaS issuance credit apply. W-004: an optional requestKey (uuid) makes the renew idempotent — a replay returns the original renewal with X-Idempotency-Replayed: true instead of creating a second draft; a keyless or different-key repeat still gets 409 RENEWAL_EXISTS.

post.summary: Re-apply from a rejected application
post.description: Citizen own/staff/admin tenant only. Creates a new DRAFT that reuses the rejected application's payload, linked via reapplicationOf so the history stays connected. The new application gets its own reference and settles its own fee at submit (the submit fee is charged again under the implemented billing model; waiving the second fee is an owner decision, not implemented). If the carried payload no longer validates against the current schema it is saved as a partial draft so the citizen can fix it. The order snapshot is not carried over; delivery choices are re-chosen under the current policy. W-004: an optional requestKey (uuid) makes the reapply idempotent — a replay returns the original re-application with X-Idempotency-Replayed: true instead of creating a second draft.

A completed query must match payment ID, amount, currency, invoice and sale intent; search additionally matches transaction ID and merchant. post.summary: Reset a stuck payment attempt so a replacement checkout can start (W-007)
post.description: Current-office admin or finance only. Supersedes the attempt (never deletes it) with a mandatory reason, recorded in the attempt event log and the audit trail. A PAID attempt cannot be reset (refund it instead); an already-SUPERSEDED attempt cannot be reset again. An attempt with a provider payment ID needs a reconcile first: the latest check must say the provider did not complete it (PENDING / PROVIDER_PAYMENT_NOT_COMPLETED) or that its evidence can never confirm (MISMATCH). A MATCHED check, an ERROR check, or no check at all refuses with 409. An attempt with no payment ID resets on the reason alone. A superseded attempt can never confirm (finalize refuses it), so exactly-once settlement holds: only the live replacement attempt can produce the application's one receipt. After a reset, a new checkout for the application creates a fresh attempt with a fresh invoice.
